job.title: Senior Frontend Product Owner Omnichannel Platform (m/w/d)
job.email_subject: Application: Senior Frontend Product Owner Omnichannel – headless & PWA commerce
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Your omnichannel frontend needs a product owner who understands the platform underneath – I built headless APIs for PWA frontends and wrote the user stories behind them at Shell and Rockwell Automation.

– Headless OCC REST APIs for PWA frontends and storefront customization
– User stories, functional specifications and UAT with business stakeholders
– Product data synchronized across global channels via PIM/ERP integrations

I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. My CV and cover letter are attached. My profile combines technical depth with close work alongside business teams, and I would bring exactly this experience to your team. Could we schedule a short call in the coming days?

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan
https://www.linkedin.com/in/kranti-chavan-84a155191

tailoring.headline: Senior Product Owner – Omnichannel Commerce | Headless & PWA Storefronts
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional e-commerce professional with 5+ years on large omnichannel commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Translates business requirements into user stories, acceptance criteria and functional specifications, works closely with stakeholders and agile teams, and understands frontends in depth: built headless OCC REST APIs for Progressive Web App (PWA) frontends and customized storefronts. Supports UAT and releases, integrates PIM and ERP data into the shop and uses AI tools for analysis and documentation.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: Deichmann is Europe's leading shoe retailer, and its omnichannel platform connects stores and online shops for millions of customers. This role sits exactly where I add most value: between customer-facing frontends, business requirements and the commerce platform behind them – a role where my techno-functional profile adds value from the first sprint.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I applied for Senior Frontend Product Owner Omnichannel: 5+ years on large commerce platforms at Shell and Rockwell Automation – headless APIs for PWA frontends, user stories, UAT. Karlsruhe, start 16.12.2026. Open to a short call?

en.subject: Application: Senior Frontend Product Owner Omnichannel Platform
en.hook: A frontend product owner for an omnichannel platform has to understand both the customer journey and what the frontend needs from the platform underneath. That is where I have worked for more than five years: at Shell and Rockwell Automation I built the headless APIs that power PWA frontends and storefronts, and turned business requirements into user stories the team could deliver.

bullets.label: Frontend & headless commerce
bullets.text: Built RESTful APIs and OCC web services for headless commerce and Progressive Web App (PWA) frontends; customized storefronts and Backoffice components.

bullets.label: Requirements & user stories
bullets.text: Analysed requirements with business stakeholders, wrote user stories and functional specifications, mapped processes with product owners and supported UAT.

bullets.label: Omnichannel data
bullets.text: Built PIM-to-commerce data pipelines that keep product catalogs synchronized across global e-commerce channels and resolved ERP/MDM integration bottlenecks.

bullets.label: Agile delivery
bullets.text: Worked in Scrum with PI Planning, executed release builds and deployment cycles and engineered API migrations for customer account structures.

en.logistics: Because I know what happens behind each frontend feature, I can shape a backlog that is ambitious and realistic at the same time. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, am open to Essen or hybrid setups and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I look forward to a conversation about Deichmann's omnichannel platform.
